Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim currentdoc As notesdocument
	Dim admindoc As notesdocument
	Dim currentdb As NotesDatabase	
	Dim admindb As New NotesDatabase("" , "Innerface\Order Entry Administration.nsf")
	Dim tempnumber As Double
	Dim adminview As notesview
	Dim key As String
	
	Set currentdb = session.CurrentDatabase
	Set adminview = admindb.GetView("(Order Number)")
	Set uidoc = workspace.currentdocument
	Set currentdoc = uidoc.document
	
'If this is not a new document, we don't want to increment the next number for this user.	
	If Not uidoc.Isnewdoc Then Exit Sub
	
'Key for view search, it selects control doc based on User's initials from the hidden field
	key = uidoc.FieldGetText("hUserInit")	
	Set admindoc = adminview.GetDocumentByKey(key)   
	
'Gets current value in control doc and adds 1 to the value	
	tempnumber = Val(admindoc.UP_NextNumber(0) + 1)
	
'Resets the control document to the next number	
	admindoc.UP_NextNumber = tempnumber   					
	
'Save and refresh	
	Call admindoc.save(True, True)
	Call uidoc.reload
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then
		currentStatus = source.FieldGetText( "OHOrdStatus" )
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And currentStatus <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		If ( currentStatus = "Released" Or currentStatus = "Pending" Or currentStatus = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to JBA or it is in pending status or is being manufactured.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	Dim docStatus As Variant
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If Isnewdoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = source.Document.OHOrdStatus
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]")And docStatus(0) <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If				
		If ( docStatus(0) = "Released" Or docStatus(0) = "Pending" Or docStatus(0) = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released for manufacture or it is in pending status.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

Sub Postopen(Source As Notesuidocument)
	
'declarations	
	Dim s As New NotesSession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim view As notesview	
	Dim doc As notesdocument
	Dim orderdoc As notesdocument, detaildoc As notesdocument	
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection
	Dim key As String
	Dim velcro As String
	Dim unid As String
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'basic setup	
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	
	Set doc = source.document
	
	Set view = db.GetView( "(Orders By Number)" )
	key = source.FieldGetText( "OHOrdNo" )
	
'get the header document and build a collection of detail items (response documents)	
	unid = source.FieldGetText("Unid")
	Set orderdoc = db.GetDocumentbyUnid( unid )	
	Set dc = orderdoc.Responses
	Set detaildoc = dc.GetFirstDocument
	
	If detaildoc Is Nothing Then	
		Messagebox "There is no detail items for this order."
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	If ( detaildoc.ODColor(0) <> "" ) Then
		doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor(0)
	Else
		If ( detaildoc.ODColor_1(0) <> "" ) Then
			doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_1(0)
		Else
			If ( detaildoc.ODColor_2(0) <> "" ) Then
				doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_2(0)
			Else
				If ( detaildoc.ODColor_3(0) <> "" ) Then
					doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_3(0)
				Else
					If ( detaildoc.ODColor_4(0) <> "" ) Then
						doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_4(0)
					Else
						doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_5(0)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If	
	End If
	
	If ( detaildoc.ODShape(0) <> "" ) Then
		doc.Shape = detaildoc.ODShape(0)
	Else
		If ( detaildoc.ODShape_1(0) <> "" ) Then
			doc.Shape = detaildoc.ODShape_1(0)
		Else
			doc.Shape = detaildoc.ODFrShape(0)
		End If
	End If
	
'loop to load the table with detail for this order	
	While Not detaildoc Is Nothing
		velcro = Right(detaildoc.JBANo(0), 2)
		If ( velcro = "VT" Or velcro = "HL" ) Then
			doc.Frame_Insert = doc.Frame_Insert(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Mount"	
		Else
			If ( detaildoc.ODColor(0) <> "" ) Then
				doc.Frame_Insert = doc.Frame_Insert(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Frame"
			Else
				doc.Frame_Insert = doc.Frame_Insert(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Insert"
			End If
		End If
		
		doc.LineNbr = doc.LineNbr(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODItem(0)
		doc.ItemNbr = doc.ItemNbr(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.JBANo(0)
		doc.Quantity = doc.Quantity(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & Cstr( detaildoc.ODQty(0) )		
		doc.Module = doc.Module(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODMod(0)
		
		'doc.arr_graph = doc.arr_graph(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODArrowDir(0) = "" ) Then
			doc.arrow = doc.arrow(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
		Else
			doc.arrow = doc.arrow(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODArrowDir(0) 
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODLetStyle(0) = "Other" ) Then
			doc.Typestyle = doc.Typestyle(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetFontSP(0)
		Else 
			If ( detaildoc.ODLetStyle(0) = "" ) Then
				doc.Typestyle = doc.Typestyle(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
			Else
				doc.Typestyle = doc.Typestyle(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetStyle(0)
			End If
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODLetUse(0) = "" ) Then
			doc.LetUse = doc.LetUse(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & ". . ."
		Else
			doc.LetUse = doc.LetUse(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetUse(0)
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODLetColor(0) = "Other" ) Then
			doc.LetColor = doc.LetColor(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetColorSP(0)
		Else 
			If ( detaildoc.ODLetColor(0) = "" ) Then
				doc.LetColor = doc.LetColor(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
			Else
				doc.LetColor = doc.LetColor(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetColor(0)
			End If
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ADACompliant(0) = "Yes" ) Then
			doc.ADAYN = doc.ADAYN(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Yes"
			doc.ADAMsg = doc.ADAMsg(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ADAMsg(0)
		Else
			If ( detaildoc.ADACompliant_1(0) = "Yes" ) Then
				doc.ADAYN = doc.ADAYN(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Yes"
				doc.ADAMsg = doc.ADAMsg(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ADAMsg_1(0)
			Else
				doc.ADAYN = doc.ADAYN(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "No"
				doc.ADAMsg = doc.ADAMsg(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & ". . ."
			End If
		End If		
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODLetMsg(0) = "" ) Then
			doc.Message = doc.Message(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & ". . ."
		Else
			doc.Message = doc.Message(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetMsg(0)
		End If
		doc.Copysize = doc.Copysize(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "__/__  "	
		
'here we draw some lines to separate the detail items		
		doc.Frame_Insert = doc.Frame_Insert(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.LineNbr = doc.LineNbr(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.ItemNbr = doc.ItemNbr(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.Quantity = doc.Quantity(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.Module = doc.Module(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.Typestyle = doc.Typestyle(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.LetUse = doc.LetUse(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.LetColor = doc.LetColor(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.arrow = doc.arrow(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"	
		'doc.arr_graph = doc.arr_graph(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.Message = doc.Message(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.ADAYN = doc.ADAYN(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.ADAMsg = doc.ADAMsg(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"
		doc.Copysize = doc.Copysize(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "___"		
		
		Set detaildoc = dc.GetNextDocument(detaildoc)	
	Wend
	
	Call source.refresh
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error	
	
End Sub

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
%REM Originally this event was to be used to collect the JBA part number and price from the item pricing
	'database.  Since the actual part number may be impossible to build from data entered here, I've
	'decided to place a button on the form to retrieve or let the user key the information manually.  This
	'is being preserved just in case we decide to turn it back on.
	
	
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim module As String
	Dim selection As String
	Dim itemNo As String	
	Dim partno As String
	Dim prefix As String
	Dim color As String
	Dim shape As String
	Dim tempprice As Double
	Dim itemdb As New NotesDatabase("" , "Innerface\Item Master.nsf")
	Dim itemview As notesview
	Dim itemdoc As notesdocument
	
	'Gather field data to create the JBA part number.
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	
	selection = uidoc.fieldgettext("ProductSelection")
	itemNo = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODItem") 
	prefix = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODPrefix")	
	module = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODMod")
	shape = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODShape")
	
	'Since we are using three different color fields, decide which part is being created and get its color value.
	If selection = "Frame" Then
		color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor")
	Else
		If selection = "Lettered Insert" Then
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_1")
		Else	
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_2")
		End If
	End If
	
	'Sign shape defaults to 00 if the user didn't make a selection.
	If shape = "" Then
		shape = "00"
	End If		
	
	'Create the part number.	
	Call uidoc.fieldsettext("JBANo", prefix + module + color + shape)
	Call uidoc.refresh	
	
	'Use the part number to retrieve the item price from the item master if the user didn't enter a price.		
	If (uidoc.Document.FixedPrice(0) = 0) Then
		partno = uidoc.fieldgettext("JBANo")
		Set itemview = itemdb.GetView("(Item Price Lookup)")	
		Set itemdoc = itemview.GetDocumentByKey(partno)
		If itemdoc Is Nothing Then		
			tempprice = 0.00
		Else			
			tempprice = itemdoc.IM_ItemPrice(0)
		End If
		uidoc.Document.FixedPrice = tempprice
	End If	
%END REM	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim docStatus As String
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim doc As NotesDocument
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set doc = source.document
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If IsNewDoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = doc.hODStatus(0)
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And docStatus <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If				
		If ( docStatus = "Released" Or docStatus = "Pending" _
		Or docStatus = "Transferred to JBA" Or docStatus = "Transferred to FMP") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released for manufacture, it is in pending status, or a Message Schedule is being created.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim currentStatus As String
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then
		currentStatus = source.FieldGetText( "hODStatus" )
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And currentStatus <> "Transferred to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		If ( currentStatus = "Released" Or currentStatus = "Pending" _
		Or currentStatus = "Transferred to JBA" Or currentStatus = "Transferred to Fmp" ) Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to JBA, released to FMP,  it is in pending status or is being manufactured.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
%REM Originally this event was to be used to collect the JBA part number and price from the item pricing
	'database.  Since the actual part number may be impossible to build from data entered here, I've
	'decided to place a button on the form to retrieve or let the user key the information manually.  This
	'is being preserved just in case we decide to turn it back on.
	
	
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim module As String
	Dim selection As String
	Dim itemNo As String	
	Dim partno As String
	Dim prefix As String
	Dim color As String
	Dim shape As String
	Dim tempprice As Double
	Dim itemdb As New NotesDatabase("" , "Innerface\Item Master.nsf")
	Dim itemview As notesview
	Dim itemdoc As notesdocument
	
	'Gather field data to create the JBA part number.
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	
	selection = uidoc.fieldgettext("ProductSelection")
	itemNo = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODItem") 
	prefix = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODPrefix")	
	module = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODMod")
	shape = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODShape")
	
	'Since we are using three different color fields, decide which part is being created and get its color value.
	If selection = "Frame" Then
		color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor")
	Else
		If selection = "Lettered Insert" Then
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_1")
		Else	
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_2")
		End If
	End If
	
	'Sign shape defaults to 00 if the user didn't make a selection.
	If shape = "" Then
		shape = "00"
	End If		
	
	'Create the part number.	
	Call uidoc.fieldsettext("JBANo", prefix + module + color + shape)
	Call uidoc.refresh	
	
	'Use the part number to retrieve the item price from the item master if the user didn't enter a price.		
	If (uidoc.Document.FixedPrice(0) = 0) Then
		partno = uidoc.fieldgettext("JBANo")
		Set itemview = itemdb.GetView("(Item Price Lookup)")	
		Set itemdoc = itemview.GetDocumentByKey(partno)
		If itemdoc Is Nothing Then		
			tempprice = 0.00
		Else			
			tempprice = itemdoc.IM_ItemPrice(0)
		End If
		uidoc.Document.FixedPrice = tempprice
	End If	
%END REM	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	Dim docStatus As Variant
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If IsNewDoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = source.Document.hODStatus
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And docStatus(0) <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If				
		If ( docStatus(0) = "Released" Or docStatus(0) = "Pending" Or docStatus(0) = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released for manufacture or it is in pending status.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim currentStatus As String
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then
		currentStatus = source.FieldGetText( "hODStatus" )
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And currentStatus <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		If ( currentStatus = "Released" Or currentStatus = "Pending" Or currentStatus = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to JBA or it is in pending status or is being manufactured.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Click(Source As Button)
	
	Dim s As New NotesSession
	Dim db As NotesDAtabase
	Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim doc As NotesDocument, detdoc As NotesDocument, headerdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument
	Dim view As NotesView, headerview As NotesView
	Dim unidvar As String
	Dim parentkey As String
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'get a handle on the input doc in the ui
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase		
	Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument
	
'save the input doc to perform on form validation.  SaveOptions is set to "0" so the doc won't be created.	
	Call uidoc.Save
	
	Set doc = uidoc.Document
	
'get the next item number from the order header
	parentkey = doc.OHOrdNo(0)	
	Set headerview = db.GetView( "(Orders by Number)" )	
	Set headerdoc = headerview.GetDocumentbyKey( parentkey )
	nextnum = headerdoc.hNextDetNum(0)
	headerdoc.hNextDetNum = headerdoc.hNextDetNum(0) + 1
	Call headerdoc.Save( True, True )
	
'validate based on frame, insert, blank
	
'create the new detail document
	Set detdoc = db.CreateDocument
	detdoc.form = "OEDtl"
	
'set new detail doc values from uidoc, repeat for all necessary fields
	detdoc.hODStatus = uidoc.FieldGetText("hODStatus")
	detdoc.hODDeliverDate = uidoc.FieldGetText("hODDeliverDate")
	detdoc.hODCono = uidoc.FieldGetText("hODCono")
	detdoc.hODJBADelDate = uidoc.FieldGetText("hODJBADelDate")
	detdoc.OHBill_CustNam = uidoc.FieldGetText("OHBill_CustNam")
	detdoc.OHBill_CustNo = uidoc.FieldGetText("OHBill_CustNo")
	detdoc.OHShipAddrCode = uidoc.FieldGetText("OHShipAddrCode")
	detdoc.OHOrdNo = uidoc.FieldGetText("OHOrdNo")
	detdoc.JBANo = uidoc.FieldGetText("JBANo")	
	detdoc.FixedPrice = uidoc.FieldGetText("FixedPrice")
	
'item information
	detdoc.ODItem = nextnum
	detdoc.ODPrefix = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODPrefix")	
	detdoc.ODMod = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODMod")	
	detdoc.ODLocation = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLocation")	
	detdoc.ODQty = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODQty")	
	detdoc.ODInnerDot = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODInnerDot")	
	detdoc.hProdType = uidoc.FieldGetText("hProdType")
	
'Case structure to create the order item detail	
	Select Case doc.hProdType(0)
		
	Case "Frame"
		detdoc.ODColor = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor")
		detdoc.ODColor_3 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor_3")	
		detdoc.ODFrMount = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODFrMount")
		detdoc.ODFrMountMtl = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODFrMountMtl")
		detdoc.ODFrShape = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODFrShape")
		detdoc.ADAMsg = uidoc.FieldGetText("ADAMsg")		
		detdoc.ADACompliant = uidoc.FieldGetText("ADACompliant")
'if the color is a standard color then we can build the JBA item number, otherwise, it will have to be done manually.		
		If ( doc.ODColor(0) <> "00" ) Then
			detdoc.JBANo = doc.ODPrefix(0) & doc.ODMod(0) & doc.ODColor(0) & doc.ODFrShape(0)
		End If
		
'additional item information
		detdoc.ODLetMsg = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetMsg")
		detdoc.ODArrowDir = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODArrowDir")	
		detdoc.ODSpIns = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODSpIns")	
'save the edit history
		detdoc.EditorsDetail = uidoc.FieldGetText("EnteredBy")
		detdoc.EditDatesDetail = Now
		detdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"	
'save the new detail doc
		Call detdoc.MakeResponse( headerdoc )
		Call detdoc.Save( True, True )
		
	Case "Lettered Insert"
		detdoc.ODInsType = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODInsType")
		detdoc.ODColor_1 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor_1")
		detdoc.ODColor_4 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor_4")
		detdoc.ODLetStyle = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetStyle")	
		detdoc.ODLetColor = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetColor")
		detdoc.ODLetColorSP = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetColorSP")
		detdoc.ODLetFontSP = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetFontSP")
		detdoc.ODLetUse = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetUse")
		detdoc.ODFormat = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODFormat")
		detdoc.ODShape = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODShape")
		detdoc.ODSymbol = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODSymbol")	
		detdoc.ADACompliant_1 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ADACompliant_1")
		detdoc.ADAMsg_1 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ADAMsg_1")	
'if the color is a standard color then we can build the JBA item number, otherwise, it will have to be done manually.		
		If ( doc.ODLetColor(0) <> "00" ) Then
			detdoc.JBANo = doc.ODPrefix(0) & doc.ODMod(0) & doc.ODLetColor(0) & doc.ODShape(0)
		End If
'additional item information
		detdoc.ODLetMsg = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetMsg")
		detdoc.ODArrowDir = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODArrowDir")	
		detdoc.ODSpIns = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODSpIns")			
'save the edit history
		detdoc.EditorsDetail = uidoc.FieldGetText("EnteredBy")
		detdoc.EditDatesDetail = Now
		detdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"		
'save the new detail doc
		Call detdoc.MakeResponse( headerdoc )
		Call detdoc.Save( True, True )
		
	Case "Blank Insert"
		detdoc.ODBlankType = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODBlankType")
		detdoc.ODColor_2 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor_2")
		detdoc.ODColor_5 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor_5")
		detdoc.ODShape_1 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODShape_1")
'if the color is a standard color then we can build the JBA item number, otherwise, it will have to be done manually.		
		If ( doc.ODColor_2(0) <> "00" ) Then
			detdoc.JBANo = doc.ODPrefix(0) & doc.ODMod(0) & doc.ODColor_2(0) & doc.ODShape_1(0)
		End If
'additional item information
		detdoc.ODLetMsg = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetMsg")
		detdoc.ODArrowDir = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODArrowDir")	
		detdoc.ODSpIns = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODSpIns")
'save the edit history
		detdoc.EditorsDetail = uidoc.FieldGetText("EnteredBy")
		detdoc.EditDatesDetail = Now
		detdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"	
'save the new detail doc
		Call detdoc.MakeResponse( headerdoc )
		Call detdoc.Save( True, True )
		
	End Select
	
'clear the input (ui) doc fields we need to clear, keep the hidden fields from the header 
'as well as color, font, letter color
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("JBANo")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("FixedPrice")
	
'item information
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODItem")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODPrefix")	
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODQty")
	Call uidoc.FieldSetText("ODInnerDot", "No")	
	
'frames
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODColor")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODFrMount")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODFrMountMtl")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODFrShape")
	Call uidoc.FieldSetText("ADACompliant" , "No")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ADAMsg")
	
'lettered inserts - we don't clear some of these fields to aid in more effecient data entry.
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODColor_1")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODColor_4")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODLetStyle")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODLetColor")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODLetColorSP")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODLetFontSP")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODLetUse")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODFormat")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODShape")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODSymbol")	
	Call uidoc.FieldSetText("ADACompliant_1" , "No")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ADAMsg_1")
	
'blank inserts	
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODBlankType")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODColor_2")
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODColor_5")	
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODShape_1")		
	
'other
	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODColor_3")
	
'additional item information
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODLetMsg")	
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODArrowDir")
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODSpIns")
	
'main hide-when trigger	
	Call uidoc.FieldClear("hProdType")
	
	Set view = db.GetView( "(evDtlCust)")
	Call view.Refresh
	Call uidoc.Refresh
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub
@If(@IsDocBeingSaved & ODPrefix = "" ; @Failure("Please enter the item prefix before saving.") ; @Success)

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	
	Dim s As New Notessession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim tempprice As Double
	Dim itemview As notesview, custview As notesview
	Dim view As NotesView		
	Dim doc As notesdocument, pricedoc As notesdocument, custdoc As notesdocument
	Dim key As String, custkey As String, partno As String, pricetype As String
	Dim price As Currency
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler	
	
'Some basic setup
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase
	Call source.refresh
	
	Dim pricedb As New Notesdatabase(db.server, "Project Management\QuoteOrderProcessing.nsf")
	Dim custdb As New NotesDatabase(db.server , "Innerface\MasterDB.nsf")	
	
	Set doc = source.document
	Set custview = custdb.GetView( "(LookupNum)" )
	Set view = pricedb.GetView( "(luModStuffCat)" )	
	key = doc.ODMod(0) & doc.ODDesc(0)
	
'Determine the price list type to use for this customer
	custkey = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0)
	Set custdoc = custview.getdocumentbykey( custkey )
	If Not custdoc Is Nothing Then
		pricetype = custdoc.CM_PriceList(0)
		
		Set pricedoc = view.GetDocumentbyKey( key, True )
		If Not pricedoc Is Nothing Then
			
			If pricetype = "BAS" Or pricetype = "" Then		
				price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(8)
			Else
				If pricetype = "GSA" Then
					price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(7)
				Else
					If pricetype = "OMH" Then
						price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(9)
					Else
						price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(13)
					End If
				End If
			End If				
			doc.FixedPrice = price
			doc.ExtPrice = price * doc.ODQty(0)	
		End If			
		
	End If
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("QuerySave - Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last erro
	
End Sub
@If(@IsDocBeingSaved & ODMod = "" ; @Failure("You must indicate a module number for this line item.") ; @Success)

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim currentdoc As notesdocument
	Dim admindoc As notesdocument
	Dim currentdb As NotesDatabase	
	Dim admindb As New NotesDatabase("AtlWeb1" , "Innerface\Order Entry Administration.nsf")
	Dim dc As NotesDocumentCollection	
	Dim respdoc As NotesDocument	
	Dim tempnumber As Double
	Dim adminview As notesview
	Dim key As String
	
	Set currentdb = session.CurrentDatabase
	Set adminview = admindb.GetView("(Order Number)")
	Set uidoc = workspace.currentdocument
	Set currentdoc = uidoc.document
	Set dc = currentdoc.Responses
	If dc.Count > 0 Then	
		Call dc.StampAll( "hODStatus" , currentdoc.OHOrdStatus(0) )
		Call dc.StampAll( "OHOrdNo" , currentdoc.OHOrdNo(0) )
	End If
	
'If this is not a new document, we don't want to increment the next number for this user.	
	If uidoc.Isnewdoc Then	
		Call admindoc.save(True, True)
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim docStatus As String
	Dim level As Integer
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.CommonUserName)
	If entry Is Nothing Then
		Set entry = acl.GetEntry( session.UserName )
	End If
	level = db.QueryAccess( session.CommonUserName )
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then	
		docStatus = source.FieldGetText( "OHOrdStatus" )
		If level >= ACLLEVEL_EDITOR And (docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped") Then
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If ( Not entry Is Nothing ) Then
			If entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And ( docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped" ) Then	
				Exit Sub
			End If		
		End If
		If ( docStatus = "To Manufacturing" Or docStatus = "To Shipping" Or docStatus = "Shipped" ) Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to manufacturing, shipping or it has been shipped.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	Dim docStatus As Variant
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim level As Integer
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	If entry Is Nothing Then
		Set entry = acl.GetEntry( session.UserName )
	End If
	level = db.QueryAccess( session.CommonUserName )
	
	'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If Isnewdoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	
	
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = source.Document.OHOrdStatus(0)
		If level >= ACLLEVEL_EDITOR And (docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped") Then
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If ( Not entry Is Nothing ) Then
			If entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And ( docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped" ) Then	
				Exit Sub
			End If		
		End If		
		If ( docStatus = "To Order Entry" Or docStatus = "To Manufacturing" Or docStatus = "To Shipping" Or docStatus = "Shipped" ) Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to manufacturing, shipping or it has been shipped.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

code_events.body:
Sub Initialize
	
'declarations
	Dim s As New notessession
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim db As notesdatabase
	Dim  view As notesview
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim doc As notesdocument, dtldoc As notesdocument
	Dim Customer As String, OrderNo As String, ItemNo As String
	Dim Quantity As String, Message As String
	Dim prekey As String	
	Dim dtlkey As String
	Dim reckey As String
	Dim cust As String
	Dim order As String
	
'ODBC declarations
	Dim orderCon As ODBCConnection     
	Dim orderQry As ODBCQuery
	Dim orderRes As ODBCResultSet	
	
'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set up ODBC	
	Set orderCon = New ODBCConnection
	Set orderQry = New ODBCQuery     
	Set orderRes = New ODBCResultSet  
	
'set up the environment and create a collection of detail documents based on the customer 
	'number and order number on this header document
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	Set doc = uidoc.document
	cust = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0)
	order = doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	prekey = doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	Set view = db.GetView("(Details By Item Number)")
	
	
'establish the ODBC connection	
	Call orderCon.ConnectTo("FileMaker Pro")	
	Set orderQry.Connection = orderCon
	
	sqlString = "SELECT * FROM Sched2K.FP5"
	orderQry.SQL = sqlString
	Set orderRes.Query = orderQry
	orderRes.Execute
	
	If (orderRes.NumRows <> 0) Then
		Do		
			orderRes.NextRow
			
			If (orderRes.GetError = DBstsSuccess) Then
				reckey = orderRes.GetValue("UNID")
				dtlkey = prekey & reckey				
				Set dtldoc = view.Getdocumentbykey(dtlkey)
				dtldoc.FixedPrice = orderRes.GetValue("UnitPrice")
				dtldoc.ODSpIns = orderRes.GetValue("SpecialInstructions")
				dtldoc.hODStatus = "Prices Updated from FMP"
				Call dtldoc.Save(True, False)
				'orderRes.DeleteRow("Sched2K.FP5")
			Else
				Print "Error retrieving " & doc.OrderNo(0) & " prices from the FMP database."
			End If
			
		Loop Until orderRes.IsEndofData
		
		orderCon.Disconnect	
		doc.OHOrdStatus = "Prices Updated from FMP"
		
		Call doc.save(True, True)
	Else
		Msgbox "No records were found for this order in FileMaker Pro", 0, "FileMaker Pro Error"
	End If
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Initialize
	
'declarations
	Dim s As New notessession
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim db As notesdatabase
	Dim  view As notesview
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim doc As notesdocument, dtldoc As notesdocument
	Dim Customer As String, OrderNo As String, ItemNo As String
	Dim Quantity As String, Message As String
	Dim key As String
	Dim dsn As String	
	Dim tablelist As Variant
	Dim msgTL As String
	Dim answer As String
	
'ODBC declarations
	Dim orderCon As ODBCConnection     
	Dim orderQry As ODBCQuery
	Dim orderRes As ODBCResultSet	
	
'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set up ODBC	
	Set orderCon = New ODBCConnection
	Set orderQry = New ODBCQuery     
	Set orderRes = New ODBCResultSet  
	
'set up the environment and create a collection of detail documents based on the customer 
	'number and order number on this header document
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	Set doc = uidoc.document
	key = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0) & doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	Set view = db.getview("(Details By Order Number)")
	Set dc = view.getalldocumentsbykey(key , True)
	Set dtldoc = dc.getfirstdocument
	
'we want to be certain that the user wants to transfer this data and we'll tell them how many documents we found.
	boxType& = MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION
	answer = Messagebox ("Do you want to transfer " + Cstr(dc.count) + " documents to FileMaker Pro!" , boxType& , "Detail Records")
	If (answer = "7") Then 
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
'establish the ODBC connection	
	Call orderCon.ConnectTo("FileMaker Pro")
	tablelist = orderCon.ListTables("FileMaker Pro")
	'Forall tables In tablelist
	'	msgTL = msgTL + tables + Chr(10)
	'End Forall
	'Messagebox msgTL, 0 , "List of available tables"
	Set orderQry.Connection = orderCon
	
'loop through the detail documents to move data to FileMaker Pro
	While Not (dtldoc Is Nothing)
		dtlunid = dtldoc.UniversalID		
		sqlString = "SELECT * FROM OrderTest.fp5"	
		orderQry.SQL = sqlString
		Set orderRes.Query = orderQry
		orderRes.Execute
		
		If Not (orderRes.IsResultSetAvailable) Then
			Messagebox "Result set is not available"
			Exit Sub
		End If
		
		If (orderRes.NumRows > 0) Then
			Exit Sub
		Else
			addStatus = orderRes.AddRow
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Customer Number" , dtldoc.OHBill_CustNo(0))
			'addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("OrderNo" , dtldoc.OHOrdNo(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Module" , dtldoc.ODMod(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Quantity" , dtldoc.ODQty(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Message" , dtldoc.ODLetMsg(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Special Instructions" , dtldoc.ODSpIns(0))			
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Location" , dtldoc.ODLocation(0))			
			'addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Price" , dtldoc.FixedPrice(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.UpdateRow
			If (addStatus <> True) Then
				Print "Error adding " & doc.OHOrdNo(0) & " to the FMP database."
			End If
			orderRes.Close(DB_Close)
		End If
		dtldoc.hODStatus = "Message Schedule"	
		Call dtldoc.save(True, True)
		Set dtldoc = dc.getnextdocument(dtldoc)
	Wend
	doc.OHOrdStatus = "Message Schedule"
	Call doc.save(True, True)

Sub Initialize

	Set view = admindb.GetView( "(luOEUsers)" )

	newdoc.OHOrdNo = order
	newdoc.OHOrdStatus = "Web - Verify"

Sub Initialize
	
'declarations
	Dim s As New notessession
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim db As notesdatabase
	Dim  view As notesview
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim doc As notesdocument, dtldoc As notesdocument
	Dim Customer As String, OrderNo As String, ItemNo As String
	Dim Quantity As String, Message As String
	Dim key As String
	Dim dsn As String	
	Dim tablelist As Variant, connected As Variant, ordstatus As Variant
	Dim msgTL As String
	Dim answer As String
	Dim fmprows As Integer
	Dim docid As String
	Dim loadheader As String
	Dim crlf As String
	Dim custinfo As String
	
'ODBC declarations
	Dim orderCon As ODBCConnection     
	Dim orderQry As ODBCQuery
	Dim orderRes As ODBCResultSet	
	
'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set the header load flag and the carriage return/line feed variable
	loadheader = "0"
	crlf$ = Chr(13) & Chr(10)
	
'set up ODBC	
	Set orderCon = New ODBCConnection
	Set orderQry = New ODBCQuery     
	Set orderRes = New ODBCResultSet  
	
'set up the environment and create a collection of detail documents based on the customer 
	'number and order number on this header document
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	Set doc = uidoc.document
	key = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0) & doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	Set view = db.getview("(Details By Order Number)")
	Set dc = view.getalldocumentsbykey(key , True)
	
'format the customer name and address for FMP	
	custinfo = doc.OHBill_CustNam(0) & crlf$ & doc.OHBill_Add1(0) & crlf$ _
	& doc.OHBill_Add2(0) & crlf$ & doc.OHBill_City(0) & ", " & doc.OHBill_State(0) & " " & doc.OHBill_ZIP(0)
	
'we want to be certain that the user wants to transfer this data and we'll tell them how many documents we found.
	boxType& = MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION
	answer = Messagebox ("Do you want to transfer " + Cstr(dc.count) + " documents to FileMaker Pro!" , boxType& , "Detail Records")
	If (answer = "7") Then 
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
'establish the ODBC connection	
	connected = orderCon.ConnectTo( "FileMaker Pro" )
	If Not connected Then
		Messagebox "Unable to connect to FileMaker Pro"
	End If
	Set orderQry.Connection = orderCon
	
'select the records in the FMP database to load detail	
	Set dtldoc = dc.getfirstdocument	
	While Not (dtldoc Is Nothing)		
		docid = dtldoc.UniversalID		
		sqlStringd = "SELECT * FROM Sched2K.FP5"	
		orderQry.SQL = sqlStringd
		Set orderRes.Query = orderQry
		orderRes.Execute
		
		If Not (orderRes.IsResultSetAvailable) Then
			Messagebox "Result set is not available"
			'Exit Sub
		End If
		
'add a new row and establish values for each field in the row			
		Call orderRes.AddRow
		
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Location" , dtldoc.ODLocation(0))			
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Module" , dtldoc.ODMod(0))		
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Quantity" , dtldoc.ODQty(0))		
		Call orderRes.SetValue("SpecialInstructions" , dtldoc.ODSpIns(0))	
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Order" , dtldoc.ODItem(0))	
		Call orderRes.SetValue("CustomerNumber" , doc.OHBill_CustNo(0))
		Call orderRes.SetValue("QuotedTo" , custinfo)
		Call orderRes.SetValue("UNID", docid)
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Header" , dtldoc.ODLetMsg(0))
		
'select group to determine which color field value to transfer to the FMP record		
		Select Case doc.hProdType(0)		
			
		Case "Frame"			
			If (ODColor <> "") Then		
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODColor(0))
			Else
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_3(0))
			End If
			
		Case "Lettered Insert"
			If (ODLetColor_1 <> "") Then
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_1(0))
			Else
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_4(0))
			End If
			
		Case "Blank Insert"			
			If (ODColor_2 <> "") Then
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_2(0))
			Else
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_5(0))
			End If
			
		End Select	
		
		ordstatus = orderRes.UpdateRow
		
		If (ordstatus <> True) Then
			Print "Error adding " & doc.OHOrdNo(0) & " detail information to the FMP database."
		End If
		
'close the result set to release the row		
		orderRes.Close(DB_Close)
		
'update the status of the Notes detail document, save, and read next		
		dtldoc.hODStatus = "Message Schedule"	
		Call dtldoc.save(True, True)
		Set dtldoc = dc.getnextdocument(dtldoc)
		
	Wend
	
'disconnect from the ODBC data source, update the status of the Notes header document and save	
	orderCon.Disconnect	
	doc.OHOrdStatus = "Message Schedule"
	Call doc.save(True, True)
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Messagebox orderRes.GetExtendedErrorMessage,, orderRes.GetErrorMessage	
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Velcro(Module As String, mounttype As String, view As NotesView, qty As Integer)
	
'declare everything	
	Dim s As New NotesSession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim dc As NotesDocumentCollection	
	Dim doc As NotesDocument, newdoc As NotesDocument, moddoc As NotesDocument, hdrdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim modview As NotesView
	Dim hdrunid As String
	Dim nextnum As Integer
	Dim modkey As String
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set up a few things	
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase	
	Set doc = s.DocumentContext	
	
'here we check to determine if this frame can be mounted with velcro...if not we bail	
	Dim moduledb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Innerface\\Product Information.nsf")	
	Set modview = moduledb.GetView( "ModInsLookup")
	modkey = module
	Set moddoc = modview.GetDocumentbyKey( modkey )
	If ( mounttype = "VT" And moddoc.CR_VT(0) = "" ) Or ( mounttype = "VTHL" And moddoc.CR_VTHL(0) = "" ) Then
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
'get the next item number from the previously saved header document
	hdrunid = doc.HdrUnid(0)
	Set hdrdoc = db.GetDocumentbyUNID( hdrunid )
	hdrdoc.NextItemNum = hdrdoc.NextItemNum(0) + 1
	nextnum = hdrdoc.NextItemNum(0)
	Call hdrdoc.Save( True, True)
	
'Basic detail document setup	
	Set newdoc = db.CreateDocument
	newdoc.Form = "OEDtl"	
	newdoc.hODStatus = "Web - In Process"
	newdoc.hODCono = "II"
	newdoc.OHBill_CustNam = doc.CustName(0)
	newdoc.OHBill_CustNo = doc.CustNum(0)
	newdoc.OHOrdNo = doc.OrderNum(0)
	newdoc.hODDeliverDate = doc.OHDate(0)
	newdoc.ODItem = nextnum
	newdoc.ODLocation = doc.ODLocation(0)
	newdoc.ODSpIns = doc.ODSpIns(0)
	newdoc.InstReq = doc.InstReq(0)		
	newdoc.EditorsDetail = "Web User"
	newdoc.EditDatesDetail = Now
	newdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"
	
'determine the part number designator for the velcro or hook and loop mount
	If mounttype = "VT" Then
		newdoc.ODOther = "Velcro Tape Mount - Hook Only"
	Else
		If mounttype = "VTHL" Then
			newdoc.ODOther = "Velcro Hook and Loop Mount"
		End If
	End If
	newdoc.ODQty = qty
	
'Create the new detail document
	Call newdoc.MakeResponse(hdrdoc)				
	Call newdoc.Save( True, True)		
	Call view.Refresh
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub CreateIPSDocs(webdoc As NotesDocument)

	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim ipsdb As New Notesdatabase( "", "Project Management\QuoteOrderProcessing.nsf")
	Dim priceview As NotesView
	Dim pricedoc As Notesdocument
	Dim rfqdc As NotesDocumentCollection

'declare error handling for entire script

	nextitem = 1	
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase
	Set priceview = ipsdb.GetView( "(luModStuffCat)" )	
	Set webhdrdoc = db.GetDocumentbyUnid( webdoc.Unid(0) )

'create and load an IPS header document for this quote
		Set qhdrdoc = ipsdb.Createdocument

		qhdrdoc.hint_ext = "Interior"

		qhdrdoc.opOrdDesc = "Request for quote submitted from the web on " + Cstr(Today)
		qhdrdoc.opAssignedTo = "Not Assigned"
		qhdrdoc.opCustNam = webhdrdoc.OHBill_CustNam(0)
		qhdrdoc.opEmail = webhdrdoc.WebEmail(0)
		qhdrdoc.opPhone = webhdrdoc.WebArea(0) + "-" + webhdrdoc.WebExchange(0) + "-" + webhdrdoc.WebPhone(0)

		qhdrdoc.opBillCustNo = webhdrdoc.OHBill_CustNo(0)

		qhdrdoc.opProject = webhdrdoc.OHOrdDesc(0)
		qhdrdoc.RepName = webhdrdoc.RepName(0)
		qhdrdoc.opInstInfo = "None"	
		qhdrdoc.opSpecialInst = webhdrdoc.OHBill_MiscInfo(0)
		
		Call qhdrdoc.Save( False, False )
		
'loop to load IPS detail documents	
		Dim rtitem As NotesRichTextItem
		Set rfqdc = webhdrdoc.Responses
		If Not rfqdc.Count = 0 Then
			Set rfqdtl = rfqdc.Getfirstdocument
			
			Do While Not rfqdtl Is Nothing
				Set dtldoc = ipsdb.Createdocument
				Call dtldoc.Makeresponse( qhdrdoc )
				dtldoc.Form = "ProjectDetail"
				dtldoc.hRepQuote = "0"
				dtldoc.opOrdNo = rfqdtl.OHOrdNo(0)
				dtldoc.opBillCustNo = rfqdtl.opBill_CustNo(0)
				dtldoc.spItemNum = nextitem
				dtldoc.dtCLoc = rfqdtl.ODLocation(0)
				dtldoc.dtCModule = Ucase( rfqdtl.ODMod(0) )
				dtldoc.dtCDesc = rfqdtl.ODDesc(0)
				dtldoc.dtCFormat = rfqdtl.ODFormat(0)
				dtldoc.dCSpIns = rfqdtl.ODSpIns(0)
				dtldoc.dtCQty = rfqdtl.ODQty(0)
				dtldoc.dtCLP = rfqdtl.ODArrowDir(0)
				dtldoc.dtCRP = rfqdtl.ODSymbol
				dtldoc.dtCMsg = rfqdtl.ODLetMsg(0)
				dtldoc.plainText = rfqdtl.ODLetMsg(0)
				dtldoc.dtCIRJCharacters = rfqdtl.ODRAText(0)				
				priceKey = Ucase(rfqdtl.ODMod(0)) + rfqdtl.ODDesc(0)
				Set pricedoc = priceview.GetDocumentByKey( priceKey, True )
				If Not pricedoc Is Nothing Then
					dtldoc.dtCPrice = pricedoc.ColumnValues( 8 )
					dtldoc.dtCXPrice = pricedoc.ColumnValues( 8 ) * rfqdtl.ODQty(0)
					dtldoc.dtCSize = pricedoc.ColumnValues( 3 )
				End If
				Call dtldoc.Save( False, False )					
				
				nextitem = nextitem + 1			
				Set rfqdtl = rfqdc.Getnextdocument( rfqdtl )
			Loop
		End If
		
	End If
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler

'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler	
	
'get a handle on the input doc in the ui and then do some basic stuff
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase		
	Set doc = s.Documentcontext
	
	If doc.unid(0) = "" Then
		If doc.Message(0) <> "" Then
			doc.plainText = doc.Message(0)
			Call doc.Save( True, True )
		End If
	Else
		Set hdrdoc = db.Getdocumentbyunid( doc.unid(0) )
		If Not hdrdoc Is Nothing Then
			If doc.Message(0) <> "" Then
				doc.plainText = doc.Message(0)
				Call doc.Save( True, True )
			End If
			hdrdoc.TotalPrice = hdrdoc.TotalPrice(0) - doc.ExtPrice(0)			
			If doc.Deleted(0) <> "Yes" Then
				doc.ExtPrice = doc.FixedPrice(0) * doc.Quantity(0)
				hdrdoc.TotalPrice = hdrdoc.TotalPrice(0) + doc.ExtPrice(0)
			End If
			Call hdrdoc.Save( True, True )						
			doc.Query_String = ""
			doc.unid = ""			
			Call doc.MakeResponse( hdrdoc )
			Call doc.Save( False, False )
		End If
	End If
	
'**************************************************************************************	
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("WebDetailMods - Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last 
	
End Sub

Sub ItemSetup(module As String, rightlen As Integer)
	
'some modules use an "A" strip but the letter "A" is not inserted into the part number if there is no "B" strip
	'and there is no "C" strip.
	Dim moduledb As New NotesDatabase( "", "Innerface\Product Information.nsf")	
	Dim modview As NotesView
	Dim moddoc As NotesDocument
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
	Set modview = moduledb.GetView( "ModInsLookup" )
	Set moddoc = modview.GetDocumentbyKey( module )
	noletter = False	
	If Not moddoc Is Nothing Then
		If moddoc.CR_HdrInsNo(0) > 0 And moddoc.CR_StripInsNo(0) = 0 And moddoc.CR_BaseInsNo(0) = 0 Then
			noletter = True
		End If
	End If
	
	If ( rightlen = 2 Or rightlen = 3 ) Then
		If Not noletter & doc.dtIType(0) <> "N" Then		
			insertletter = doc.dtIType(0)
		Else
			insertletter = "0"
		End If
	Else
		If Not noletter & doc.dtIType(0) <> "N" Then				
			insertletter = "0" & doc.dtIType(0)
		Else
			insertletter = "00"
		End If
	End If
	
	If doc.spInsColor(0) <> "00 Other (Specify)" Then	
		insertcolor = doc.spInsColor(0)
	Else
		'insertcolor = "99"
		insertcolor = "00"
	End If		
	
'if a module has an A strip, B strips, and a C strip then the shape code for the B strips is always "00"	
'if there is an A strip or a C strip shapes are always "00" or "01" 	
	If doc.dtIType(0) = "B" Then	
		If moddoc.CR_HdrInsNo(0) > 0 And moddoc.CR_StripInsNo(0) > 0 And moddoc.CR_BaseInsNo(0) > 0 Then
			shape = "00"
		Else
			shape = doc.spShape(0)	
		End If
	Else
		If doc.spShape(0) = "01" Or doc.spShape(0) = "00"  Then
			shape = "00"
		Else
			shape = "10"
		End If
	End If
	
	If detdoc.dtIBlank(0) = "No" Then
		partnum = "04" & module & insertletter & insertcolor & shape
		dummypart = "04" & module & insertletter
	Else
		partnum = "05" & module & insertletter & insertcolor & shape
		dummypart = "05" & module & insertletter
	End If
	
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub ReportProcessing
	
	Dim s As New Notessession
	Dim ws As New Notesuiworkspace
	Dim db As Notesdatabase
	Dim dc As Notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim view As NotesUIView
	Dim docDlg As Notesdocument
	Dim IHandle As Long
	Dim szFormat As String, szID As String
	Dim iFormatStore As Integer, iPrintSetup As Integer
	Dim iErr As Variant
	Dim rcode, i%
	Dim IPformat As String, IPoperation As String
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'some basic setup	
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set view = ws.CurrentView	
	
'create a form that won't be saved to display the subform for user selection	
	Set docDlg = db.CreateDocument
	docDlg.SaveOptions = "0"
	docDlg.Form = "IPDlg"
	
'let the user select the report format and the processing option	
	rcode = ws.Dialogbox("IPDlg", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Report Printing", docDlg, False, False)
	
'bail if they made no selection	
	If Not rcode Then End
	IPformat = docDlg.Format(0)
	IPoperation = docDlg.Operation(0)
	
'load docs to be printed or previewed	
	Set seldc = db.UnprocessedDocuments
	If seldc.count <> 0 Then
		Set doc = seldc.GetFirstDocument
		If doc.Form(0) <> "OEHeader" Then
			boxType = MB_YESNO + MB_ICONEXCLAMATION 
			crlf$ = Chr(13) & Chr(10)                                                ' Carriage return/line feed
			Messagebox "The selected document is not a header type document.", boxType, "INVALID DOCUMENT SELECTED"
			Exit Sub
		End If
		
		If IPformat = "Credit Card Validation" Then
			szID$ = szID$ + doc.NoteID			
		Else
			Set dc = doc.Responses
			For i = 1 To dc.Count
				Set doc = dc.GetNthDocument(i)
				szID$ = szID$ + doc.NoteID + ";"
			Next
		End If
		
'initialize IntelliPRINTPLUS and get its handle
		IHandle = IPSInitialize(db.Server, db.Filepath, "")
		
'launch IPP if we got the handle	
		If IHandle <> 0 Then
			szFormat = IPformat
			iFormatStore = 0
			iErr = IPSOpenFormat(IHandle, szFormat, iFormatStore, db.Server, db.Filepath)
			If iErr = 0 Then
				Select Case docDlg.Operation(0)
				Case "Preview"
					Call IPSPreview(IHandle, szID$, 0)
				Case "Print"
					Call IPSPrint(IHandle, szID$, 1)
					
				End Select		
			Else
				Msgbox "iErr is " & iErr
			End If
			
			IPSCloseFormat(IHandle)
			IPSTerminate(IHandle)
			
		End If
	End If
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkspace
	Dim currentdoc As notesdocument
	Dim admindoc As notesdocument
	Dim currentdb As NotesDatabase	
	Dim admindb As New NotesDatabase("" , "Innerface\Order Entry Administration.nsf")
	Dim tempnumber As Double
	Dim adminview As notesview
	Dim key As String
	
	Set currentdb = session.CurrentDatabase
	Set adminview = admindb.GetView("(Order Number)")
	Set uidoc = workspace.currentdocument
	Set currentdoc = uidoc.document
	
'If this is not a new document, we don't want to increment the next number for this user.	
	If Not uidoc.Isnewdoc Then Exit Sub
	
'Key for view search, it selects control doc based on User's initials from the hidden field
	key = uidoc.FieldGetText("hUserInit")	
	Set admindoc = adminview.GetDocumentByKey(key)   
	
'Gets current value in control doc and adds 1 to the value	
	tempnumber = Val(admindoc.UP_NextNumber(0) + 1)
	
'Resets the control document to the next number	
	admindoc.UP_NextNumber = tempnumber   					
	
'Save and refresh	
	Call admindoc.save(True, True)
	Call uidoc.reload
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then
		currentStatus = source.FieldGetText( "OHOrdStatus" )
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And currentStatus <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		If ( currentStatus = "Released" Or currentStatus = "Pending" Or currentStatus = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to JBA or it is in pending status or is being manufactured.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	Dim docStatus As Variant
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If Isnewdoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = source.Document.OHOrdStatus
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]")And docStatus(0) <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If				
		If ( docStatus(0) = "Released" Or docStatus(0) = "Pending" Or docStatus(0) = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released for manufacture or it is in pending status.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

Sub Postopen(Source As Notesuidocument)
	
'declarations	
	Dim s As New NotesSession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim view As notesview	
	Dim doc As notesdocument
	Dim orderdoc As notesdocument, detaildoc As notesdocument	
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection
	Dim key As String
	Dim velcro As String
	Dim unid As String
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'basic setup	
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	
	Set doc = source.document
	
	Set view = db.GetView( "(Orders By Number)" )
	key = source.FieldGetText( "OHOrdNo" )
	
'get the header document and build a collection of detail items (response documents)	
	unid = source.FieldGetText("Unid")
	Set orderdoc = db.GetDocumentbyUnid( unid )	
	Set dc = orderdoc.Responses
	Set detaildoc = dc.GetFirstDocument
	
	If detaildoc Is Nothing Then	
		Messagebox "There is no detail items for this order."
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
	If ( detaildoc.ODColor(0) <> "" ) Then
		doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor(0)
	Else
		If ( detaildoc.ODColor_1(0) <> "" ) Then
			doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_1(0)
		Else
			If ( detaildoc.ODColor_2(0) <> "" ) Then
				doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_2(0)
			Else
				If ( detaildoc.ODColor_3(0) <> "" ) Then
					doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_3(0)
				Else
					If ( detaildoc.ODColor_4(0) <> "" ) Then
						doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_4(0)
					Else
						doc.Color = detaildoc.ODColor_5(0)
					End If
				End If
			End If
		End If	
	End If
	
	If ( detaildoc.ODShape(0) <> "" ) Then
		doc.Shape = detaildoc.ODShape(0)
	Else
		If ( detaildoc.ODShape_1(0) <> "" ) Then
			doc.Shape = detaildoc.ODShape_1(0)
		Else
			doc.Shape = detaildoc.ODFrShape(0)
		End If
	End If
	
'loop to load the table with detail for this order	
	While Not detaildoc Is Nothing
		velcro = Right(detaildoc.JBANo(0), 2)
		If ( velcro = "VT" Or velcro = "HL" ) Then
			doc.Frame_Insert = doc.Frame_Insert(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Mount"	
		Else
			If ( detaildoc.ODColor(0) <> "" ) Then
				doc.Frame_Insert = doc.Frame_Insert(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Frame"
			Else
				doc.Frame_Insert = doc.Frame_Insert(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Insert"
			End If
		End If
		
		doc.LineNbr = doc.LineNbr(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODItem(0)
		doc.ItemNbr = doc.ItemNbr(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.JBANo(0)
		doc.Quantity = doc.Quantity(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & Cstr( detaildoc.ODQty(0) )		
		doc.Module = doc.Module(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODMod(0)
		
		'doc.arr_graph = doc.arr_graph(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODArrowDir(0) = "" ) Then
			doc.arrow = doc.arrow(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
		Else
			doc.arrow = doc.arrow(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODArrowDir(0) 
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODLetStyle(0) = "Other" ) Then
			doc.Typestyle = doc.Typestyle(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetFontSP(0)
		Else 
			If ( detaildoc.ODLetStyle(0) = "" ) Then
				doc.Typestyle = doc.Typestyle(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
			Else
				doc.Typestyle = doc.Typestyle(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetStyle(0)
			End If
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODLetUse(0) = "" ) Then
			doc.LetUse = doc.LetUse(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & ". . ."
		Else
			doc.LetUse = doc.LetUse(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetUse(0)
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ODLetColor(0) = "Other" ) Then
			doc.LetColor = doc.LetColor(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetColorSP(0)
		Else 
			If ( detaildoc.ODLetColor(0) = "" ) Then
				doc.LetColor = doc.LetColor(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  &  ". . ."
			Else
				doc.LetColor = doc.LetColor(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ODLetColor(0)
			End If
		End If
		
		If ( detaildoc.ADACompliant(0) = "Yes" ) Then
			doc.ADAYN = doc.ADAYN(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Yes"
			doc.ADAMsg = doc.ADAMsg(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ADAMsg(0)
		Else
			If ( detaildoc.ADACompliant_1(0) = "Yes" ) Then
				doc.ADAYN = doc.ADAYN(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & "Yes"
				doc.ADAMsg = doc.ADAMsg(0) & Chr$(13) & Chr$(10)  & detaildoc.ADAMsg_1(0)

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
%REM Originally this event was to be used to collect the JBA part number and price from the item pricing
	'database.  Since the actual part number may be impossible to build from data entered here, I've
	'decided to place a button on the form to retrieve or let the user key the information manually.  This
	'is being preserved just in case we decide to turn it back on.
	
	
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim module As String
	Dim selection As String
	Dim itemNo As String	
	Dim partno As String
	Dim prefix As String
	Dim color As String
	Dim shape As String
	Dim tempprice As Double
	Dim itemdb As New NotesDatabase("" , "Innerface\Item Master.nsf")
	Dim itemview As notesview
	Dim itemdoc As notesdocument
	
	'Gather field data to create the JBA part number.
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	
	selection = uidoc.fieldgettext("ProductSelection")
	itemNo = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODItem") 
	prefix = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODPrefix")	
	module = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODMod")
	shape = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODShape")
	
	'Since we are using three different color fields, decide which part is being created and get its color value.
	If selection = "Frame" Then
		color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor")
	Else
		If selection = "Lettered Insert" Then
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_1")
		Else	
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_2")
		End If
	End If
	
	'Sign shape defaults to 00 if the user didn't make a selection.
	If shape = "" Then
		shape = "00"
	End If		
	
	'Create the part number.	
	Call uidoc.fieldsettext("JBANo", prefix + module + color + shape)
	Call uidoc.refresh	
	
	'Use the part number to retrieve the item price from the item master if the user didn't enter a price.		
	If (uidoc.Document.FixedPrice(0) = 0) Then
		partno = uidoc.fieldgettext("JBANo")
		Set itemview = itemdb.GetView("(Item Price Lookup)")	
		Set itemdoc = itemview.GetDocumentByKey(partno)
		If itemdoc Is Nothing Then		
			tempprice = 0.00
		Else			
			tempprice = itemdoc.IM_ItemPrice(0)
		End If
		uidoc.Document.FixedPrice = tempprice
	End If	
%END REM	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim docStatus As String
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim doc As NotesDocument
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set doc = source.document
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If IsNewDoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = doc.hODStatus(0)
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And docStatus <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If				
		If ( docStatus = "Released" Or docStatus = "Pending" _
		Or docStatus = "Transferred to JBA" Or docStatus = "Transferred to FMP") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released for manufacture, it is in pending status, or a Message Schedule is being created.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim currentStatus As String
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then
		currentStatus = source.FieldGetText( "hODStatus" )
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And currentStatus <> "Transferred to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		If ( currentStatus = "Released" Or currentStatus = "Pending" _
		Or currentStatus = "Transferred to JBA" Or currentStatus = "Transferred to Fmp" ) Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to JBA, released to FMP,  it is in pending status or is being manufactured.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
%REM Originally this event was to be used to collect the JBA part number and price from the item pricing
	'database.  Since the actual part number may be impossible to build from data entered here, I've
	'decided to place a button on the form to retrieve or let the user key the information manually.  This
	'is being preserved just in case we decide to turn it back on.
	
	
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim module As String
	Dim selection As String
	Dim itemNo As String	
	Dim partno As String
	Dim prefix As String
	Dim color As String
	Dim shape As String
	Dim tempprice As Double
	Dim itemdb As New NotesDatabase("" , "Innerface\Item Master.nsf")
	Dim itemview As notesview
	Dim itemdoc As notesdocument
	
	'Gather field data to create the JBA part number.
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	
	selection = uidoc.fieldgettext("ProductSelection")
	itemNo = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODItem") 
	prefix = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODPrefix")	
	module = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODMod")
	shape = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODShape")
	
	'Since we are using three different color fields, decide which part is being created and get its color value.
	If selection = "Frame" Then
		color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor")
	Else
		If selection = "Lettered Insert" Then
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_1")
		Else	
			color = uidoc.fieldgettext("ODColor_2")
		End If
	End If
	
	'Sign shape defaults to 00 if the user didn't make a selection.
	If shape = "" Then
		shape = "00"
	End If		
	
	'Create the part number.	
	Call uidoc.fieldsettext("JBANo", prefix + module + color + shape)
	Call uidoc.refresh	
	
	'Use the part number to retrieve the item price from the item master if the user didn't enter a price.		
	If (uidoc.Document.FixedPrice(0) = 0) Then
		partno = uidoc.fieldgettext("JBANo")
		Set itemview = itemdb.GetView("(Item Price Lookup)")	
		Set itemdoc = itemview.GetDocumentByKey(partno)
		If itemdoc Is Nothing Then		
			tempprice = 0.00
		Else			
			tempprice = itemdoc.IM_ItemPrice(0)
		End If
		uidoc.Document.FixedPrice = tempprice
	End If	
%END REM	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	Dim docStatus As Variant
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry					
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If IsNewDoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = source.Document.hODStatus
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And docStatus(0) <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If				
		If ( docStatus(0) = "Released" Or docStatus(0) = "Pending" Or docStatus(0) = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released for manufacture or it is in pending status.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim currentStatus As String
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then
		currentStatus = source.FieldGetText( "hODStatus" )
		If (entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And currentStatus <> "Entered to JBA") Then	
			Exit Sub
		End If		
		If ( currentStatus = "Released" Or currentStatus = "Pending" Or currentStatus = "Entered to JBA") Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to JBA or it is in pending status or is being manufactured.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Click(Source As Button)
	
	Dim s As New NotesSession

'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'get a handle on the input doc in the ui

	Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument
	
'save the input doc to perform on form validation.  SaveOptions is set to "0" so the doc won't be created.

	Set doc = uidoc.Document
	
'get the next item number from the order header
	parentkey = doc.OHOrdNo(0)	
	Set headerview = db.GetView( "(Orders by Number)" )	
	Set headerdoc = headerview.GetDocumentbyKey( parentkey )
	nextnum = headerdoc.hNextDetNum(0)
	headerdoc.hNextDetNum = headerdoc.hNextDetNum(0) + 1
	Call headerdoc.Save( True, True )
	
'validate based on frame, insert, blank
	
'create the new detail document
	Set detdoc = db.CreateDocument
	detdoc.form = "OEDtl"
	
'set new detail doc values from uidoc, repeat for all necessary fields
	detdoc.hODStatus = uidoc.FieldGetText("hODStatus")

'item information
	detdoc.ODItem = nextnum
	detdoc.ODPrefix = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODPrefix")	
	detdoc.ODMod = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODMod")

'Case structure to create the order item detail	
	Select Case doc.hProdType(0)
		
	Case "Frame"
		detdoc.ODColor = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor")
		detdoc.ODColor_3 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor_3")	
		detdoc.ODFrMount = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODFrMount")

			detdoc.JBANo = doc.ODPrefix(0) & doc.ODMod(0) & doc.ODColor(0) & doc.ODFrShape(0)
		End If
		
'additional item information
		detdoc.ODLetMsg = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODLetMsg")
		detdoc.ODArrowDir = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODArrowDir")	
		detdoc.ODSpIns = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODSpIns")	
'save the edit history
		detdoc.EditorsDetail = uidoc.FieldGetText("EnteredBy")
		detdoc.EditDatesDetail = Now
		detdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"	
'save the new detail doc
		Call detdoc.MakeResponse( headerdoc )
		Call detdoc.Save( True, True )
		
	Case "Lettered Insert"
		detdoc.ODInsType = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODInsType")
		detdoc.ODColor_1 = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODColor_1")

		detdoc.ODArrowDir = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODArrowDir")	
		detdoc.ODSpIns = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODSpIns")			
'save the edit history
		detdoc.EditorsDetail = uidoc.FieldGetText("EnteredBy")
		detdoc.EditDatesDetail = Now
		detdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"		
'save the new detail doc
		Call detdoc.MakeResponse( headerdoc )
		Call detdoc.Save( True, True )
		
	Case "Blank Insert"
		detdoc.ODBlankType = uidoc.FieldGetText("ODBlankType")

		detdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"	
'save the new detail doc
		Call detdoc.MakeResponse( headerdoc )
		Call detdoc.Save( True, True )
		
	End Select
	
'clear the input (ui) doc fields we need to clear, keep the hidden fields from the header

	Call uidoc.FieldClear("FixedPrice")

'frames

	'Call uidoc.FieldClear("ODColor_2")

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	
	Dim s As New Notessession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim tempprice As Double
	Dim itemview As notesview, custview As notesview
	Dim view As NotesView		
	Dim doc As notesdocument, pricedoc As notesdocument, custdoc As notesdocument
	Dim key As String, custkey As String, partno As String, pricetype As String
	Dim price As Currency
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler	
	
'Some basic setup
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase
	Call source.refresh
	
	Dim pricedb As New Notesdatabase(db.server, "Project Management\QuoteOrderProcessing.nsf")
	Dim custdb As New NotesDatabase(db.server , "Innerface\MasterDB.nsf")	
	
	Set doc = source.document
	Set custview = custdb.GetView( "(LookupNum)" )
	Set view = pricedb.GetView( "(luModStuffCat)" )	
	key = doc.ODMod(0) & doc.ODDesc(0)
	
'Determine the price list type to use for this customer
	custkey = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0)
	Set custdoc = custview.getdocumentbykey( custkey )
	If Not custdoc Is Nothing Then
		pricetype = custdoc.CM_PriceList(0)
		
		Set pricedoc = view.GetDocumentbyKey( key, True )
		If Not pricedoc Is Nothing Then
			
			If pricetype = "BAS" Or pricetype = "" Then		
				price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(8)
			Else
				If pricetype = "GSA" Then
					price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(7)
				Else
					If pricetype = "OMH" Then
						price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(9)
					Else
						price = pricedoc.ColumnValues(13)
					End If
				End If
			End If				
			doc.FixedPrice = price
			doc.ExtPrice = price * doc.ODQty(0)	
		End If			
		
	End If
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("QuerySave - Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last erro
	
End Sub

Sub Querymodechange(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant)
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim docStatus As String
	Dim level As Integer
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.CommonUserName)
	If entry Is Nothing Then
		Set entry = acl.GetEntry( session.UserName )
	End If
	level = db.QueryAccess( session.CommonUserName )
	
	If Not ( source.EditMode ) Then	
		docStatus = source.FieldGetText( "OHOrdStatus" )
		If level >= ACLLEVEL_EDITOR And (docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped") Then
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If ( Not entry Is Nothing ) Then
			If entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And ( docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped" ) Then	
				Exit Sub
			End If		
		End If
		If ( docStatus = "To Manufacturing" Or docStatus = "To Shipping" Or docStatus = "Shipped" ) Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to manufacturing, shipping or it has been shipped.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"
			continue = False
		End If
	End If
	
End Sub

Sub Queryopen(Source As Notesuidocument, mode As Integer, Isnewdoc As Variant, Continue As Variant)
	Dim docStatus As Variant
	Dim userType As Variant
	Dim session As New NotesSession				
	Dim workspace As New NotesUIWorkSpace				
	Dim db As NotesDatabase					
	Dim acl As NotesACL						
	Dim entry As NotesACLEntry	
	Dim level As Integer
	
	Set db = session.CurrentDatabase				
	Set acl = db.ACL						
	Set entry = acl.GetEntry(session.UserName)
	If entry Is Nothing Then
		Set entry = acl.GetEntry( session.UserName )
	End If
	level = db.QueryAccess( session.CommonUserName )
	
	'If this is a new document in edit mode, no need to run the edit check routine.
	If Isnewdoc Or source.InPreviewPane Then Exit Sub
	
	
	If mode = 1 Then
		docStatus = source.Document.OHOrdStatus(0)
		If level >= ACLLEVEL_EDITOR And (docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped") Then
			Exit Sub
		End If
		If ( Not entry Is Nothing ) Then
			If entry.IsRoleEnabled("[Administrators]") And ( docStatus <> "To Manufacturing" And docStatus <> "To Shipping" And docStatus <> "Shipped" ) Then	
				Exit Sub
			End If		
		End If		
		If ( docStatus = "To Order Entry" Or docStatus = "To Manufacturing" Or docStatus = "To Shipping" Or docStatus = "Shipped" ) Then
			Messagebox _
			"Either this order has been released to manufacturing, shipping or it has been shipped.  The document is available for browsing only.", ,"Editing Is Not Allowed!"

		End If
	End If	
	
End Sub

Sub Initialize
	
'declarations
	Dim s As New notessession
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim db As notesdatabase
	Dim  view As notesview
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim doc As notesdocument, dtldoc As notesdocument
	Dim Customer As String, OrderNo As String, ItemNo As String
	Dim Quantity As String, Message As String
	Dim prekey As String	
	Dim dtlkey As String
	Dim reckey As String
	Dim cust As String
	Dim order As String
	
'ODBC declarations
	Dim orderCon As ODBCConnection     
	Dim orderQry As ODBCQuery
	Dim orderRes As ODBCResultSet	
	
'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set up ODBC	
	Set orderCon = New ODBCConnection
	Set orderQry = New ODBCQuery     
	Set orderRes = New ODBCResultSet  
	
'set up the environment and create a collection of detail documents based on the customer 
	'number and order number on this header document
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	Set doc = uidoc.document
	cust = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0)
	order = doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	prekey = doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	Set view = db.GetView("(Details By Item Number)")
	
	
'establish the ODBC connection	
	Call orderCon.ConnectTo("FileMaker Pro")	
	Set orderQry.Connection = orderCon
	
	sqlString = "SELECT * FROM Sched2K.FP5"
	orderQry.SQL = sqlString
	Set orderRes.Query = orderQry
	orderRes.Execute
	
	If (orderRes.NumRows <> 0) Then
		Do		
			orderRes.NextRow
			
			If (orderRes.GetError = DBstsSuccess) Then
				reckey = orderRes.GetValue("UNID")
				dtlkey = prekey & reckey				
				Set dtldoc = view.Getdocumentbykey(dtlkey)
				dtldoc.FixedPrice = orderRes.GetValue("UnitPrice")
				dtldoc.ODSpIns = orderRes.GetValue("SpecialInstructions")
				dtldoc.hODStatus = "Prices Updated from FMP"
				Call dtldoc.Save(True, False)
				'orderRes.DeleteRow("Sched2K.FP5")
			Else
				Print "Error retrieving " & doc.OrderNo(0) & " prices from the FMP database."
			End If
			
		Loop Until orderRes.IsEndofData
		
		orderCon.Disconnect	
		doc.OHOrdStatus = "Prices Updated from FMP"
		
		Call doc.save(True, True)
	Else
		Msgbox "No records were found for this order in FileMaker Pro", 0, "FileMaker Pro Error"
	End If
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Initialize
	
'declarations
	Dim s As New notessession

	Dim db As notesdatabase
	Dim  view As notesview
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument

	Dim Quantity As String, Message As String
