	Dim msgTL As String
	Dim answer As String
	
'ODBC declarations
	Dim orderCon As ODBCConnection     
	Dim orderQry As ODBCQuery
	Dim orderRes As ODBCResultSet	
	
'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set up ODBC	
	Set orderCon = New ODBCConnection
	Set orderQry = New ODBCQuery     
	Set orderRes = New ODBCResultSet  
	
'set up the environment and create a collection of detail documents based on the customer 
	'number and order number on this header document
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	Set doc = uidoc.document
	key = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0) & doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	Set view = db.getview("(Details By Order Number)")
	Set dc = view.getalldocumentsbykey(key , True)
	Set dtldoc = dc.getfirstdocument
	
'we want to be certain that the user wants to transfer this data and we'll tell them how many documents we found.
	boxType& = MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION
	answer = Messagebox ("Do you want to transfer " + Cstr(dc.count) + " documents to FileMaker Pro!" , boxType& , "Detail Records")
	If (answer = "7") Then 
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
'establish the ODBC connection	
	Call orderCon.ConnectTo("FileMaker Pro")
	tablelist = orderCon.ListTables("FileMaker Pro")
	'Forall tables In tablelist
	'	msgTL = msgTL + tables + Chr(10)
	'End Forall
	'Messagebox msgTL, 0 , "List of available tables"
	Set orderQry.Connection = orderCon
	
'loop through the detail documents to move data to FileMaker Pro
	While Not (dtldoc Is Nothing)
		dtlunid = dtldoc.UniversalID		
		sqlString = "SELECT * FROM OrderTest.fp5"	
		orderQry.SQL = sqlString
		Set orderRes.Query = orderQry
		orderRes.Execute
		
		If Not (orderRes.IsResultSetAvailable) Then
			Messagebox "Result set is not available"
			Exit Sub
		End If
		
		If (orderRes.NumRows > 0) Then
			Exit Sub
		Else
			addStatus = orderRes.AddRow
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Customer Number" , dtldoc.OHBill_CustNo(0))
			'addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("OrderNo" , dtldoc.OHOrdNo(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Module" , dtldoc.ODMod(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Quantity" , dtldoc.ODQty(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Message" , dtldoc.ODLetMsg(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Special Instructions" , dtldoc.ODSpIns(0))			
			addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Location" , dtldoc.ODLocation(0))			
			'addStatus = orderRes.SetValue("Price" , dtldoc.FixedPrice(0))
			addStatus = orderRes.UpdateRow
			If (addStatus <> True) Then
				Print "Error adding " & doc.OHOrdNo(0) & " to the FMP database."
			End If
			orderRes.Close(DB_Close)
		End If
		dtldoc.hODStatus = "Message Schedule"	
		Call dtldoc.save(True, True)
		Set dtldoc = dc.getnextdocument(dtldoc)
	Wend
	doc.OHOrdStatus = "Message Schedule"
	Call doc.save(True, True)
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Initialize

Sub Initialize
	
	'declare everything
	Dim s As New NotesSession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim dc As NotesDocumentCollection
	Dim doc As notesDocument, olddoc As NotesDocument, newdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim numdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim detdoc As NotesDocument, newdetdoc As NotesDocument

	Dim view As Notesview
	Dim counter As Integer
	Dim maildoc As NotesDocument
	
	'Declare error handling for entire script

	'set up things and get the URL string that called the agent to find the target UNID
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase
	Set doc = s.DocumentContext
	
	unid = Mid$( doc.Query_String(0) , Instr( doc.Query_String(0) , "ID=") + 3)
	
	'Get the source order and details
	Set olddoc = db.GetDocumentbyUNID( unid )
	customer = olddoc.OHBill_CustNam(0)	
	Set dc = olddoc.Responses
	
	'Create the new order
	Dim admindb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Innerface\Order Entry Administration.nsf")
	Set view = admindb.GetView( "(luOEUsers)" )
	key = "Web User"
	Set numdoc = view.GetDocumentbyKey( key , True )
	order = "WEB" + Trim(Str$(numdoc.UP_NextNumber(0)))
	numdoc.UP_NextNumber = numdoc.UP_NextNumber(0) + 1
	Call numdoc.Save( True, True)
	
	Set newdoc = olddoc.CopytoDatabase( db )
	newdoc.OHDate = Now
	newdoc.OHOrdNo = order
	newdoc.OHOrdStatus = "Web - Verify"
	Call newdoc.Save( True, True)
	
	'create the new details
	Set detdoc = dc.GetFirstDocument
	counter = 1
	Do Until detdoc Is Nothing
		Set newdetdoc = detdoc.CopytoDatabase( db )

		newdetdoc.OHOrdNo = order

		newdetdoc.ODLocation = ""

	Loop

	Call maildoc.Send( False, maildoc.SendTo(0) )

	'send the user to our pleasant and confidence-inspiring thank you page.
	Print "[/Innerface/Order+Entry.nsf/ThankYouForm?OpenForm&Order=" & order & "]"
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler

	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Initialize
	
'This routine runs when the web customer presses the "Submit" button.  We modify the status of the order document
	'which causes the scheduled agent to notify the CSR that an order has arrived.  Then we create a Project document
	'which will be tracked through the system until the order goes to manufacturing.
	
	Dim s As New NotesSession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim dc As NotesDocumentCollection	
	Dim doc As NotesDocument, hdrdoc As NotesDocument, dtldoc As NotesDocument, custdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim repdoc As NotesDocument, projdoc As NotesDocument, mvmtdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim view As NotesView, custview As NotesView, repview As NotesView
	Dim unid As String, hdrunid As String, custkey As String, repkey As String
	Dim module As String
	Dim newunid As String
	Dim dccount As Integer
	Dim uniqueno As Variant
	Dim i As Integer
	Dim thankyouord As String, zeros As String, tracknum As String, rndnum As String
	
'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'Get a handle on the current document	
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase	
	Set doc = s.DocumentContext
	tracknum = doc.hTrackNum(0)
	rndnum = doc.hRndOrd(0)
	
'Use the unid of the header document to get a handle on it	
	newunid = doc.HdrUnid(0)	
	Set hdrdoc = db.GetDocumentbyUNID( newunid )
	
'The user pressed the Cancel button, remove all docs and bail	
	If ( doc.cancelByte(0) = "1" ) Then	
		If Not hdrdoc Is Nothing Then
			Set dc = hdrdoc.Responses
			Call dc.RemoveAll(True)
			Call hdrdoc.Remove(True)
		End If
		Print "[/Innerface/Order+Entry.nsf/Web+Select?OpenForm]"
		Exit Sub		
	End If
	
'put this customer's sales rep name and number on the header document	
	If doc.CustNum(0) <> "" Then	
		Dim custdb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Innerface\MasterDB.nsf" )	
		Set custview = custdb.GetView( "(LookupNum)" )
		custkey = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0)
		Set custdoc = custview.GetDocumentbyKey( custkey, True )
		If ( Not custdoc Is Nothing ) Then	
			hdrdoc.RepName = custdoc.ColumnValues( 4 )
			hdrdoc.RepNbr = custdoc.ColumnValues( 5 )
			hdrdoc.pmCustRmk = custdoc.CM_Remarks(0)
			hdrdoc.pmSandH = custdoc.CM_SandH(0)
			If custdoc.CM_BillDiscount(0) <> "" Then
				hdrdoc.pmCustDisc = "Yes"
				hdrdoc.pmCustDiscCode = custdoc.CM_BillDiscount(0)					
			Else
				hdrdoc.pmCustDisc = "No"
			End If
		Else
			hdrdoc.RepName = "New Customer"
			hdrdoc.RepNbr = "000"
		End If
		
		custdoc.CM_MiscInfo = hdrdoc.OHBill_MiscInfo(0)
		Call custdoc.Save( True, True )
	End If
	
'since we're saving this new order we need to increment the next order number.
	Dim admindb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Innerface\Order Entry Administration.nsf")
	Dim adminview As Notesview
	Dim ordnum As String, key As String
	
	Set adminview = admindb.GetView( "(luOEUsers)" )
	key = "Web User"
	
	Dim numdoc As Notesdocument			
	Set numdoc = adminview.GetDocumentbyKey( key , True)
	ordnum = Cstr( numdoc.UP_NextNumber(0) )			
	numdoc.UP_NextNumber = numdoc.UP_NextNumber(0) + 1
	Call numdoc.Save( True, True)	
	
	If Cint(ordnum) < 10 Then
		zeros = "0000"
	Else
		If Cint(ordnum) < 100 Then
			zeros = "000"
		Else
			If Cint(ordnum) < 1000 Then
				zeros = "00"
			Else
				If Cint(ordnum) < 10000 Then
					zeros = "0"
				Else
					zeros = ""
				End If
			End If
		End If
	End If
	thankyouord = "W" & zeros & Cstr(ordnum)
	
'Change the status to verify
	hdrdoc.OHOrdStatus = "Web - Verify"
	hdrdoc.OHOrdNo = thankyouord
	hdrdoc.OHProject = thankyouord
	Call hdrdoc.Save( True, True)		
	
'And do the same for all of the response docs (details)	
	Set dc = hdrdoc.Responses
	dccount = dc.Count
	'Call dc.StampAll( "WebConf", uniqueno)	
	Call dc.StampAll("hODStatus", "Web - Verify")
	Call dc.StampAll("OHOrdNo", thankyouord )
	
'create the new project document in the Project Tracking database and initialize
	Dim projdb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Project Management\ProjectTrack.nsf" )		
	Set projdoc = projdb.CreateDocument
	projdoc.form = "Project"
	projdoc.int_ext = "Interior"
	projdoc.dateCreated = Cdat( Today )
	projdoc.pmQuoteOrder = "Order"
	projdoc.pmStatus = "Customer Service"
	projdoc.pmCustomer = hdrdoc.OHBill_CustNam(0)	
	projdoc.pmNumber = thankyouord
	projdoc.pmName = hdrdoc.OHBill_CustNam(0)	
	projdoc.pmCustNo = hdrdoc.OHBill_CustNo(0)
	projdoc.pmPONbr = hdrdoc.OHPONumber(0)
	projdoc.pmCtcName = hdrdoc.WebName(0)	
	projdoc.pmCtcEmail = hdrdoc.WebEmail(0)
	projdoc.pmCtrctYN = "No"
	projdoc.pmOrigin = "Online Web Order (old site)"
	
	If hdrdoc.WebPhone(0) <> "" Then	
		projdoc.pmCtcPhone = "(" + hdrdoc.WebArea(0) + ") " + hdrdoc.WebExchange(0) + "-" + hdrdoc.WebPhone(0)
	End If
	If hdrdoc.FaxPhone(0) <> "" Then	
		projdoc.pmCtcFax = "(" + hdrdoc.FaxArea(0) + ") " + hdrdoc.FaxExchange(0) + "-" + hdrdoc.FaxPhone(0)
	End If
	If doc.CustNum(0) <> "" Then	
		projdoc.pmSalesRep = custdoc.CM_RepName(0)
	End If
	projdoc.onLocation = "1"
	projdoc.pmTotalDays = 0
	projdoc.pmAvgDays = 0
	projdoc.pmSignageTotal = 0
	projdoc.hDept = "Customer Service"
	projdoc.hDateIn = Today
	projdoc.hCustStatus = "Quote in House"	
	projdoc.lastDateOut = Cstr( Today )
	
	Dim dateTime As New NotesDateTime( Today )
	'Dim holddate As Variant	
	Call dateTime.AdjustMonth( 3 )
	'Set holddate = dateTime
	projdoc.adjdate = dateTime.LSLocalTime
	
	projdoc.SearchDate = Today
	
'here we place the sales rep's manager's name on the project document	
	Dim repdb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Sales\SalesRep.nsf" )	
	Set repview = repdb.GetView( "repsbyNumber" )
	repkey = hdrdoc.RepNbr(0)
	Set repdoc = repview.GetDocumentbyKey( repkey )
	If ( Not repdoc Is Nothing ) Then	
		projdoc.repsmgr = repdoc.repManager(0)
	Else
		projdoc.repsmgr = "Unknown"
	End If
	
	Call projdoc.Save( False, False )
	
'we need to create a response document to show movement from the web to the project tracker.
	Set mvmtdoc = projdb.CreateDocument
	mvmtdoc.Form = "ProjectMovement"
	Call mvmtdoc.MakeResponse( projdoc )	
	mvmtdoc.pmNumber = thankyouord
	mvmtdoc.pmCustomer = projdoc.pmCustomer(0)
	mvmtdoc.pmCustNo = projdoc.pmCustNo(0)
	mvmtdoc.Form = "ProjectMovement"
	mvmtdoc.projDept = "Customer Service"
	mvmtdoc.projPerson = projdoc.pmCSRPlnr(0)
	mvmtdoc.projDateIn = Today
	mvmtdoc.projReason = "New web order arrived"
	mvmtdoc.onLocationResp = "1"
	Call mvmtdoc.Save( False, False )
	
'in this loop, we will look for details that have a zero quantity indicating that the user has deleted
	'the item.
	For i = 1 To dccount
		Set dtldoc = dc.GetNthDocument( i )		
		If dtldoc.ODQty(0) = 0 Then 
			Call dtldoc.Remove(True)
		End If
	Next
	
'Send the user to our pleasant Thank You page
	'Print "[/Innerface/Order+Entry.nsf/ThankYouForm?OpenForm&Order=" & thankyouord & "]"
	Print "[/Innerface/Order+Entry.nsf/ThankYouForm?OpenForm&TrackNumber=" + tracknum + "&Random=" + rndnum + "&Order=" + thankyouord + "]"		
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("StatusToVerify - Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Initialize
	
'declarations
	Dim s As New notessession
	Dim ws As New notesuiworkspace
	Dim db As notesdatabase
	Dim  view As notesview
	Dim dc As notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim uidoc As notesuidocument
	Dim doc As notesdocument, dtldoc As notesdocument
	Dim Customer As String, OrderNo As String, ItemNo As String
	Dim Quantity As String, Message As String
	Dim key As String
	Dim dsn As String	
	Dim tablelist As Variant, connected As Variant, ordstatus As Variant
	Dim msgTL As String
	Dim answer As String
	Dim fmprows As Integer
	Dim docid As String
	Dim loadheader As String
	Dim crlf As String
	Dim custinfo As String
	
'ODBC declarations
	Dim orderCon As ODBCConnection     
	Dim orderQry As ODBCQuery
	Dim orderRes As ODBCResultSet	
	
'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set the header load flag and the carriage return/line feed variable
	loadheader = "0"
	crlf$ = Chr(13) & Chr(10)
	
'set up ODBC	
	Set orderCon = New ODBCConnection
	Set orderQry = New ODBCQuery     
	Set orderRes = New ODBCResultSet  
	
'set up the environment and create a collection of detail documents based on the customer 
	'number and order number on this header document
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set uidoc = ws.currentdocument
	Set doc = uidoc.document
	key = doc.OHBill_CustNo(0) & doc.OHOrdNo(0)
	Set view = db.getview("(Details By Order Number)")
	Set dc = view.getalldocumentsbykey(key , True)
	
'format the customer name and address for FMP	
	custinfo = doc.OHBill_CustNam(0) & crlf$ & doc.OHBill_Add1(0) & crlf$ _
	& doc.OHBill_Add2(0) & crlf$ & doc.OHBill_City(0) & ", " & doc.OHBill_State(0) & " " & doc.OHBill_ZIP(0)
	
'we want to be certain that the user wants to transfer this data and we'll tell them how many documents we found.
	boxType& = MB_YESNO+MB_ICONQUESTION
	answer = Messagebox ("Do you want to transfer " + Cstr(dc.count) + " documents to FileMaker Pro!" , boxType& , "Detail Records")
	If (answer = "7") Then 
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
'establish the ODBC connection	
	connected = orderCon.ConnectTo( "FileMaker Pro" )
	If Not connected Then
		Messagebox "Unable to connect to FileMaker Pro"
	End If
	Set orderQry.Connection = orderCon
	
'select the records in the FMP database to load detail	
	Set dtldoc = dc.getfirstdocument	
	While Not (dtldoc Is Nothing)		
		docid = dtldoc.UniversalID		
		sqlStringd = "SELECT * FROM Sched2K.FP5"	
		orderQry.SQL = sqlStringd
		Set orderRes.Query = orderQry
		orderRes.Execute
		
		If Not (orderRes.IsResultSetAvailable) Then
			Messagebox "Result set is not available"
			'Exit Sub
		End If
		
'add a new row and establish values for each field in the row			
		Call orderRes.AddRow
		
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Location" , dtldoc.ODLocation(0))			
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Module" , dtldoc.ODMod(0))		
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Quantity" , dtldoc.ODQty(0))		
		Call orderRes.SetValue("SpecialInstructions" , dtldoc.ODSpIns(0))	
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Order" , dtldoc.ODItem(0))	
		Call orderRes.SetValue("CustomerNumber" , doc.OHBill_CustNo(0))
		Call orderRes.SetValue("QuotedTo" , custinfo)
		Call orderRes.SetValue("UNID", docid)
		Call orderRes.SetValue("Header" , dtldoc.ODLetMsg(0))
		
'select group to determine which color field value to transfer to the FMP record		
		Select Case doc.hProdType(0)		
			
		Case "Frame"			
			If (ODColor <> "") Then		
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODColor(0))
			Else
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_3(0))
			End If
			
		Case "Lettered Insert"
			If (ODLetColor_1 <> "") Then
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_1(0))
			Else
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_4(0))
			End If
			
		Case "Blank Insert"			
			If (ODColor_2 <> "") Then
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_2(0))
			Else
				Call orderRes.SetValue("ColorBox" , dtldoc.ODLetColor_5(0))
			End If
			
		End Select	
		
		ordstatus = orderRes.UpdateRow
		
		If (ordstatus <> True) Then
			Print "Error adding " & doc.OHOrdNo(0) & " detail information to the FMP database."
		End If
		
'close the result set to release the row		
		orderRes.Close(DB_Close)
		
'update the status of the Notes detail document, save, and read next		
		dtldoc.hODStatus = "Message Schedule"	
		Call dtldoc.save(True, True)
		Set dtldoc = dc.getnextdocument(dtldoc)
		
	Wend
	
'disconnect from the ODBC data source, update the status of the Notes header document and save	
	orderCon.Disconnect	
	doc.OHOrdStatus = "Message Schedule"
	Call doc.save(True, True)
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Messagebox orderRes.GetExtendedErrorMessage,, orderRes.GetErrorMessage	
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub Initialize

	Dim s As New NotesSession

	Dim doc As notesDocument, olddoc As NotesDocument, newdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim numdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim detdoc As NotesDocument, newdetdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim unid As String
	Dim view As Notesview
	
	 'Declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
	'set up things and get the URL string that called the agent to find the target UNID
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase
	Set doc = s.DocumentContext
	unid = Mid$( doc.Query_String(0) , Instr( doc.Query_String(0) , "ID=") + 3)
	
	'Get the source order and details
	Set olddoc = db.GetDocumentbyUNID( unid )
	Set dc = olddoc.Responses
	
	'Create the new order
	Dim admindb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Innerface\\Order Entry Administration.nsf")
	Set view = admindb.GetView( "OEUsersName" )
	Set numdoc = view.GetDocumentbyKey( "Web User" , True)

	newdoc.OHDate = Now
	newdoc.OHOrdNo = "WEB" + Trim(Str$(numdoc.UP_NextNumber(0)))
	newdoc.OHOrdStatus = "Web"
	Call newdoc.Save( True, True)
	numdoc.UP_NextNumber = numdoc.UP_NextNumber(0) + 1
	Call numdoc.Save( True, True)

	Set detdoc = dc.GetFirstDocument

		newdetdoc.OHDate = Now
		newdetdoc.OHOrdNo = newdoc.OHOrdNoS
		newdetdoc.OHOrdStatus = "Web"
		Call newdetdoc.MakeResponse( newdoc )
		Call newdetdoc.Save( True, True)
		Set detdoc = dc.GetNextDocument( detdoc )
	Loop
	
	'send the user to the next webpage
	Print "[/innerface/Order+Entry.nsf/Web+Select?OpenForm]"
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler

Sub Velcro(Module As String, mounttype As String, view As NotesView, qty As Integer)
	
'declare everything	
	Dim s As New NotesSession
	Dim db As NotesDatabase
	Dim dc As NotesDocumentCollection	
	Dim doc As NotesDocument, newdoc As NotesDocument, moddoc As NotesDocument, hdrdoc As NotesDocument
	Dim modview As NotesView
	Dim hdrunid As String
	Dim nextnum As Integer
	Dim modkey As String
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'set up a few things	
	Set db = s.CurrentDatabase	
	Set doc = s.DocumentContext	
	
'here we check to determine if this frame can be mounted with velcro...if not we bail	
	Dim moduledb As New NotesDatabase( db.server, "Innerface\\Product Information.nsf")	
	Set modview = moduledb.GetView( "ModInsLookup")
	modkey = module
	Set moddoc = modview.GetDocumentbyKey( modkey )
	If ( mounttype = "VT" And moddoc.CR_VT(0) = "" ) Or ( mounttype = "VTHL" And moddoc.CR_VTHL(0) = "" ) Then
		Exit Sub
	End If
	
'get the next item number from the previously saved header document
	hdrunid = doc.HdrUnid(0)
	Set hdrdoc = db.GetDocumentbyUNID( hdrunid )
	hdrdoc.NextItemNum = hdrdoc.NextItemNum(0) + 1
	nextnum = hdrdoc.NextItemNum(0)
	Call hdrdoc.Save( True, True)
	
'Basic detail document setup	
	Set newdoc = db.CreateDocument
	newdoc.Form = "OEDtl"	
	newdoc.hODStatus = "Web - In Process"
	newdoc.hODCono = "II"
	newdoc.OHBill_CustNam = doc.CustName(0)
	newdoc.OHBill_CustNo = doc.CustNum(0)
	newdoc.OHOrdNo = doc.OrderNum(0)
	newdoc.hODDeliverDate = doc.OHDate(0)
	newdoc.ODItem = nextnum
	newdoc.ODLocation = doc.ODLocation(0)
	newdoc.ODSpIns = doc.ODSpIns(0)
	newdoc.InstReq = doc.InstReq(0)		
	newdoc.EditorsDetail = "Web User"
	newdoc.EditDatesDetail = Now
	newdoc.EditSequenceDetail = "1"
	
'determine the part number designator for the velcro or hook and loop mount
	If mounttype = "VT" Then
		newdoc.ODOther = "Velcro Tape Mount - Hook Only"
	Else
		If mounttype = "VTHL" Then
			newdoc.ODOther = "Velcro Hook and Loop Mount"
		End If
	End If
	newdoc.ODQty = qty
	
'Create the new detail document
	Call newdoc.MakeResponse(hdrdoc)				
	Call newdoc.Save( True, True)		
	Call view.Refresh
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub ItemSetup(module As String, rightlen As Integer)
	
'some modules use an "A" strip but the letter "A" is not inserted into the part number if there is no "B" strip
	'and there is no "C" strip.
	Dim moduledb As New NotesDatabase( "", "Innerface\Product Information.nsf")	
	Dim modview As NotesView
	Dim moddoc As NotesDocument
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
	Set modview = moduledb.GetView( "ModInsLookup" )
	Set moddoc = modview.GetDocumentbyKey( module )
	noletter = False	
	If Not moddoc Is Nothing Then
		If moddoc.CR_HdrInsNo(0) > 0 And moddoc.CR_StripInsNo(0) = 0 And moddoc.CR_BaseInsNo(0) = 0 Then
			noletter = True
		End If
	End If
	
	If ( rightlen = 2 Or rightlen = 3 ) Then
		If Not noletter & doc.dtIType(0) <> "N" Then		
			insertletter = doc.dtIType(0)
		Else
			insertletter = "0"
		End If
	Else
		If Not noletter & doc.dtIType(0) <> "N" Then				
			insertletter = "0" & doc.dtIType(0)
		Else
			insertletter = "00"
		End If
	End If
	
	If doc.spInsColor(0) <> "00 Other (Specify)" Then	
		insertcolor = doc.spInsColor(0)
	Else
		'insertcolor = "99"
		insertcolor = "00"
	End If		
	
'if a module has an A strip, B strips, and a C strip then the shape code for the B strips is always "00"	
'if there is an A strip or a C strip shapes are always "00" or "01" 	
	If doc.dtIType(0) = "B" Then	
		If moddoc.CR_HdrInsNo(0) > 0 And moddoc.CR_StripInsNo(0) > 0 And moddoc.CR_BaseInsNo(0) > 0 Then
			shape = "00"
		Else
			shape = doc.spShape(0)	
		End If
	Else
		If doc.spShape(0) = "01" Or doc.spShape(0) = "00"  Then
			shape = "00"
		Else
			shape = "10"
		End If
	End If
	
	If detdoc.dtIBlank(0) = "No" Then
		partnum = "04" & module & insertletter & insertcolor & shape
		dummypart = "04" & module & insertletter
	Else
		partnum = "05" & module & insertletter & insertcolor & shape
		dummypart = "05" & module & insertletter
	End If
	
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub

Sub ReportProcessing
	
	Dim s As New Notessession
	Dim ws As New Notesuiworkspace
	Dim db As Notesdatabase
	Dim dc As Notesdocumentcollection	
	Dim view As NotesUIView
	Dim docDlg As Notesdocument
	Dim IHandle As Long
	Dim szFormat As String, szID As String
	Dim iFormatStore As Integer, iPrintSetup As Integer
	Dim iErr As Variant
	Dim rcode, i%
	Dim IPformat As String, IPoperation As String
	
'declare error handling for entire script
	On Error Goto Errorhandler
	
'some basic setup	
	Set db = s.currentdatabase
	Set view = ws.CurrentView	
	
'create a form that won't be saved to display the subform for user selection	
	Set docDlg = db.CreateDocument
	docDlg.SaveOptions = "0"
	docDlg.Form = "IPDlg"
	
'let the user select the report format and the processing option	
	rcode = ws.Dialogbox("IPDlg", True, True, False, False, False, False, "Report Printing", docDlg, False, False)
	
'bail if they made no selection	
	If Not rcode Then End
	IPformat = docDlg.Format(0)
	IPoperation = docDlg.Operation(0)
	
'load docs to be printed or previewed	
	Set seldc = db.UnprocessedDocuments
	If seldc.count <> 0 Then
		Set doc = seldc.GetFirstDocument
		If doc.Form(0) <> "OEHeader" Then
			boxType = MB_YESNO + MB_ICONEXCLAMATION 
			crlf$ = Chr(13) & Chr(10)                                                ' Carriage return/line feed
			Messagebox "The selected document is not a header type document.", boxType, "INVALID DOCUMENT SELECTED"
			Exit Sub
		End If
		
		If IPformat = "Credit Card Validation" Then
			szID$ = szID$ + doc.NoteID			
		Else
			Set dc = doc.Responses
			For i = 1 To dc.Count
				Set doc = dc.GetNthDocument(i)
				szID$ = szID$ + doc.NoteID + ";"
			Next
		End If
		
'initialize IntelliPRINTPLUS and get its handle
		IHandle = IPSInitialize(db.Server, db.Filepath, "")
		
'launch IPP if we got the handle	
		If IHandle <> 0 Then
			szFormat = IPformat
			iFormatStore = 0
			iErr = IPSOpenFormat(IHandle, szFormat, iFormatStore, db.Server, db.Filepath)
			If iErr = 0 Then
				Select Case docDlg.Operation(0)
				Case "Preview"
					Call IPSPreview(IHandle, szID$, 0)
				Case "Print"
					Call IPSPrint(IHandle, szID$, 1)
					
				End Select		
			Else
				Msgbox "iErr is " & iErr
			End If
			
			IPSCloseFormat(IHandle)
			IPSTerminate(IHandle)
			
		End If
	End If
	
	Exit Sub 'Exit the sub before the errorhandler
	
ErrorHandler:
	Print("Error Number " + Cstr(Err) + " : " + Error$ + " on line number " + Cstr(Erl)) 
	Resume Next 'Continue where the agent encountered the last error
	
End Sub
